papers.title: 南通市中考英语模拟试卷（一）
papers.structureNote: 按2025南通改革结构精简：覆盖全部7大题型，题量约为真实卷2/3，用于日常训练与App题库。

questions.stem: —How long ___ you ___ English? —For three years.
questions.analysis: 考查现在完成时。'For three years' 为延续性时间状语，需用 have/has + 过去分词；主语 you 用 have。

questions.stem: The moonlight goes ___ the window and makes the room bright.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。月光'从窗户内部穿过'用 through；across 指表面穿过，over 指越过，past 指经过。

questions.stem: —___ I use your bike? —Sure, here you are.
questions.analysis: 考查情态动词。请求许可且语气委婉用 May I...?；Must 表必须，Need 表需要，均不符语境。

questions.stem: My little brother enjoys ___ model planes in his free time.
questions.analysis: 考查非谓语动词。enjoy 后接动名词 doing，固定搭配 enjoy doing sth.

questions.stem: —Thank you for helping me with my homework. —___
questions.analysis: 考查情景交际。回应感谢用 You're welcome；Never mind 用于安慰或回应道歉。

questions.stem: Can you ___ the difference between the twins? They look so similar.
questions.analysis: 考查动词辨析。tell the difference 为固定搭配，意为'辨别差异'；say/speak/talk 无此用法。

questions.stem: It was raining heavily, ___ we had to stay at home.
questions.analysis: 考查连词。前后为因果关系（雨大→只能待在家），用 so 表结果；because 表原因需置于前因。

questions.stem: After practicing for a month, he plays basketball ___ than before.
questions.analysis: 考查比较级。than 前用比较级，good/well 的比较级为 better。

questions.stem: Could you tell me ___ the nearest hospital is?
questions.analysis: 考查宾语从句。从句缺地点状语（医院'在哪里'），用 where 引导且用陈述语序。

questions.stem: The weather in Nantong is nicer than ___ in Beijing in spring.
questions.analysis: 考查代词。比较结构中用 that 指代前文同类异物（weather）；it 指代同一事物，one 指代单数可数名词。

sections.name: 完形填空
sections.passage: Last winter holiday, I learned to make paper cuttings from my grandmother. At first, it was not easy. The red paper was thin and my hands were not ____(1)____ enough. I made many mistakes and wanted to ____(2)____. But Grandma smiled and said, 'Patience is the ____(3)____ to art.' She showed me how to hold the scissors ____(4)____. Day by day, I became better. Now I can cut beautiful flowers and birds. I feel ____(5)____ when I give them to my friends. This traditional skill teaches me to be ____(6)____. It also helps me understand Chinese ____(7)____ better. I hope to ____(8)____ it with more young people.

questions.analysis: 剪纸需手'稳'，steady 符合语境；strong 强、quick 快、clever 聪明均不贴切。
前文'犯了好多错'自然想'放弃'，give up 符合；go on 继续、come back 回来、look out 小心。
the key to ... 为固定搭配，意为'…的关键'。
剪纸需'小心地'握剪刀，carefully 符合；happily 开心地、quickly 快地、loudly 大声地均不符。
把作品送给朋友时应感到'自豪'，proud 符合；sad 难过、tired 累、bored 无聊不符。
前文 Grandma 强调 patience，此处呼应'学会耐心'，patient 符合。
剪纸是传统'文化'，culture 符合；food 食物、music 音乐、science 科学不符。
'与更多年轻人分享'用 share，符合传承语境；compare 比较、argue 争论、fight 打架不符。

passages.title: Sunshine English Club Recruitment
passages.body:
Sunshine English Club is looking for new members!
● Who: Students in Grade 7–9 who love English.
● Activities: English movies, role-play, and a weekly speech show.
● Time: Every Friday 4:00–5:00 p.m.
● Place: School Library, Room 205.
● Fee: Free.
● How to join: Send an email to englishclub@school.com before September 30.
Come and improve your English with us!

questions.stem: Who can join the club?
options: B. Students in Grade 7–9 who love English
questions.analysis: 细节题。海报'Who'一行明确为 Grade 7–9 且热爱英语的学生。

questions.stem: When is the club activity?
questions.analysis: 细节题。'Time'一行写明每周五下午 4–5 点。

questions.stem: How can a student join?
options: C. Send an email before Sept 30
questions.analysis: 细节题。'How to join'写明九月三十日前发邮件；Fee 为 Free 排除付费。

passages.title: Li Ming and His Calligraphy
passages.body: Li Ming, a 14-year-old boy, used to dislike writing. His handwriting was messy, and he felt ashamed. One day, his grandfather gave him a brush and said, 'Good writing needs a calm heart.' Li Ming started to practice calligraphy every evening. At first, his words looked ugly, and his friends laughed at him. But he didn't give up. Half a year later, he won first prize in the school writing contest. Now he understands that patience and practice can change a person. He also helps younger students learn calligraphy.

questions.stem: Why did Li Ming dislike writing at first?
questions.analysis: 细节题。首段'His handwriting was messy, and he felt ashamed'说明起因。

questions.stem: What did his grandfather tell him?
options: B. Good writing needs a calm heart
questions.analysis: 细节题。祖父原话'Good writing needs a calm heart.'

questions.stem: What can we learn from Li Ming's story?
options: A. Laughing at others is fun
B. Patience and practice change a person
questions.analysis: 主旨/推理题。末段点明'patience and practice can change a person'，为文章升华主题。

passages.title: How to Improve Your English
passages.body:
English is useful, but many students find it hard. Here are some ways to help you.
____(1)____ Read English stories or news every day, even for ten minutes. It builds your sense of the language.
____(2)____ Don't be afraid of making mistakes. Speak with classmates or record your own voice.
____(3)____ Keep a small notebook for new words and review them often.
____(4)____ Watching English cartoons helps you learn how words are used in life.
____(5)____ Learning takes time, so keep going and you will see progress.
options: A. Listen to English songs and watch cartoons.
B. Read a little every day.

questions.stem: 空白 (1) 应选
questions.analysis: 后句'Read English stories... every day'对应'每天读一点'，B 为段落主旨。

questions.stem: 空白 (2) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'Don't be afraid of making mistakes... Speak'对应'勇敢练习说'，C 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (3) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'notebook for new words... review'对应'记下新单词'，D 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (4) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'Watching English cartoons'对应'听歌看卡通'，A 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (5) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'keep going... see progress'对应'不要轻易放弃'，E 匹配；F 为干扰项（未提及 club）。

questions.stem: We should listen to the teacher ___ (careful) in class.
questions.analysis: 修饰动词 listen 用副词，careful→carefully。

questions.stem: My cousin ___ (visit) the museum next weekend.
questions.analysis: 时间 next weekend 表将来，用一般将来时 will visit / is going to visit。

questions.stem: There are many ___ (difference) between the two pictures.
questions.analysis: many 后接可数名词复数，difference→differences。

questions.stem: The book is ___ (use) because it helps me a lot.
questions.analysis: 作表语用形容词，use→useful（有用的）。

questions.stem: They ___ (finish) the project yesterday.
questions.analysis: yesterday 表过去，动词用过去式 finish→finished。

questions.stem: It's important ___ (read) more books.
questions.analysis: It's + adj. + to do 固定句型，用不定式。

sections.name: 短文填空
sections.passage: In our city, more people choose to go to work by ____(1)____ to protect the environment. Riding a bike not only ____(2)____ energy but also keeps us ____(3)____. We should also learn to ____(4)____ things in daily life. For example, we can use both ____(5)____ of the paper. Small actions can make a big ____(6)____.

questions.analysis: 后句'Riding a bike'提示填 bike（固定表达 by bike）。
主语 riding a bike 单数，一般现在时动词用 saves。
keep + sb. + adj.，health→healthy（保持健康）。
环保语境'重复使用'，reuse 符合。
both 后接复数，side→sides（纸的两面）。
make a difference 固定搭配'起作用/有影响'。

sections.name: 阅读与回答问题
sections.passage: Li Hua is a junior high school student. Every Sunday, he volunteers at an old people's home near his school. He helps the old clean their rooms and reads newspapers for them. Sometimes he plays chess with Grandpa Wang. 'I feel happy when I help others,' Li Hua says. 'Volunteering teaches me to care about people around me.'

questions.stem: Where does Li Hua volunteer?
questions.answer: At an old people's home (near his school).
questions.analysis: 细节定位首句。

questions.stem: How often does he go there?
questions.analysis: 细节'Every Sunday'。

questions.stem: What does he do there?
questions.answer: He helps clean rooms, reads newspapers and plays chess.
questions.analysis: 综合第二、三句。

questions.stem: Why does he like volunteering?
questions.answer: Because it makes him happy and teaches him to care about others.
questions.analysis: 末句直接引用。

sections.name: 书面表达
sections.prompt: 假定你是李华，你的英国笔友 Tom 想了解中国的传统节日。请你写一封邮件向他介绍春节（the Spring Festival），内容包括：1. 春节的时间；2. 主要活动（吃团圆饭、贴春联、收红包等）；3. 你的感受。
sections.referenceOutline: 要点1 时间（农历正月初一/一月或二月）；要点2 活动（family dinner, put up couplets, get red packets）；要点3 感受（warm, happy, my favourite festival）
sections.referenceVersion: Dear Tom, I'm glad to tell you about the Spring Festival, the most important traditional festival in China. It usually comes in January or February. On that day, families get together and enjoy a big dinner. We put up red couplets on the doors and children can get red packets from elders. I feel warm and happy because it's a time full of love. It's my favourite festival. Hope you can experience it one day! Yours, Li Hua
sections.analysis: 评分要点：覆盖三要点、时态以一般现在时为主、使用连接词（and, because）、词数达标；常见失分：遗漏要点、中式英语、时态混乱。

papers.title: 南通市中考英语模拟试卷（二）
papers.structureNote: 按2025南通改革结构精简：覆盖全部7大题型。

questions.stem: Many useful apps ___ by Chinese developers every year.
questions.analysis: 考查被动语态。every year 表经常性，用一般现在时被动；apps 复数→are created。

questions.stem: The AI tool ___ I used yesterday is very helpful.
questions.analysis: 考查定语从句。先行词 tool 指物，用 which/that 引导。

questions.stem: If it ___ rainy tomorrow, we will have the meeting online.
questions.analysis: 考查状语从句。if 条件句遵循主将从现，从句用一般现在时。

questions.stem: You ___ park here. There is a 'No Parking' sign.
questions.analysis: 考查情态动词。标志牌禁止停车，用 mustn't 表'禁止'。

questions.stem: We usually have a school meeting ___ Monday morning.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。具体某天的上午用 on。

questions.stem: Scientists ___ a new way to turn used plastic into fuel.
questions.analysis: 考查动词辨析。discover 指'发现'原本存在的事物/方法；invent 指发明新事物。

questions.stem: With the new method, the work becomes much ___ than before.
questions.analysis: 考查比较级。than 前用比较级，easy 的比较级为 easier。

questions.stem: Please remember ___ off the lights when you leave.
questions.analysis: 考查非谓语动词。remember to do 指'记得去做（尚未做）'。

questions.stem: —Could you help me carry the box? —___
questions.analysis: 考查情景交际。回应求助且乐意帮忙用 Of course。

questions.stem: Some students like reading, while ___ prefer sports.
questions.analysis: 考查代词。others = other students，与前面的 some 对应。

sections.name: 完形填空
sections.passage: When I was in Grade 7, I found English very difficult. I was afraid to speak in class because I made many ___ (1) ___. Then my teacher introduced an AI app to me. It could correct my pronunciation and explain grammar ___ (2) ___. At first, I thought it was just a ___ (3) ___ and wouldn't help much. But after a month, my scores went ___ (4) ___. The app didn't do the work for me; it taught me how to ___ (5) ___. However, my teacher warned us not to ___ (6) ___ too much on it. 'Technology is a tool, not a ___ (7) ___,' she said. Now I use AI wisely and enjoy learning. I believe a good learner knows how to ___ (8) ___ the best of technology.

questions.analysis: 前文'不敢开口'是因为常犯'错误'，mistakes 符合。
AI'清晰地'讲解语法，clearly 符合语境。
起初以为它只是个'游戏'，game 符合'不会有多大帮助'的轻视语气。
成绩'提高'用 go up，与后文 improved 呼应。
App 教我如何'学习'，learn 符合。
depend on 固定搭配，意为'依赖'；老师提醒不要过度依赖。
老师强调科技是工具而非'老师'，teacher 符合。
make the best of 为固定搭配，意为'充分利用'。

passages.title: Green Tech Summer Camp
passages.body:
Want to learn about robots and green energy? Join our Green Tech Summer Camp!
● Date: July 10–15
● Place: City Science Museum
● Activities: Build a small robot, visit a solar power station, make a recycled model.
● Cost: 200 yuan (lunch included)
● Sign up: Fill the form at the school office before July 1.
Seats are limited!

questions.stem: What can students do at the camp?
options: A. Build a robot and visit a solar station
questions.analysis: 细节题。Activities 一行列出建机器人、参观太阳能站、做回收模型。

questions.stem: Where is the camp?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Place 一行写明 City Science Museum。

questions.stem: How can students sign up?
options: B. Fill the form at school office before July 1
questions.analysis: 细节题。Sign up 一行写明在校办公室填表且截止 7 月 1 日。

passages.title: My Friend and the AI
passages.body: My friend Lucy used to copy answers from an AI tool to finish her homework. Her grades looked good, but she learned little. One day, her teacher found out and said, 'AI should help you think, not think for you.' Lucy felt sorry. She started to use AI only to check her ideas and learn new words. Slowly, she really improved. Now she says, 'I am the boss of the AI, not its follower.'

questions.stem: What did Lucy use to do?
questions.analysis: 细节题。首句说明她过去用 AI 抄答案。

questions.stem: What did the teacher tell her?
options: B. AI should help you think, not think for you
questions.analysis: 细节题。老师原话'AI should help you think, not think for you.'

questions.stem: What does Lucy learn at last?
options: B. She should be the boss of AI
questions.analysis: 推理题。末句'I am the boss of the AI'点明人应主导 AI。

passages.title: Live a Low-carbon Life
passages.body:
Our earth is getting warmer. A low-carbon life helps protect it.
____(1)____ Turn off lights and fans when you leave a room. Small acts save energy.
____(2)____ Riding a bike or walking is better than driving. It also keeps you fit.
____(3)____ Take a cloth bag when shopping instead of using plastic bags.
____(4)____ Reuse paper and bottles, and sort your rubbish.
____(5)____ If everyone does a little, the world will be a better place.

questions.stem: 空白 (1) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'关灯关风扇省电'对应'节约用电'，A 为段落主旨。

questions.stem: 空白 (2) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'骑车或步行优于开车'对应'绿色出行'，B 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (3) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'用布袋代替塑料袋'对应'减少塑料使用'，C 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (4) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'重复利用、垃圾分类'对应'reuse and recycle'，D 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (5) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'每人做一点'对应'从自己做起'，E 匹配；F 为干扰项。

questions.stem: The film was ___ (interest), so we watched it twice.
questions.analysis: 修饰物用 -ing 形容词 interesting（令人感兴趣的）。

questions.stem: More trees ___ (plant) in our city last year.
questions.analysis: trees 与 plant 为被动关系，last year 用一般过去时被动 were planted。

questions.stem: He is ___ (good) at physics than his brother.
questions.analysis: than 前用比较级，good 的比较级为 better。

questions.stem: We should stop ___ (use) plastic bags.
questions.analysis: stop doing 指'停止正在做的事'，此处停止用塑料袋。

questions.stem: The ___ (invent) of the computer changed the world.
questions.analysis: 定冠词后接名词，invent→invention（发明）。

questions.stem: It is necessary ___ (save) water every day.
questions.analysis: It is + adj. + to do 固定句型，用不定式。

sections.name: 短文填空
sections.passage: To protect the earth, we should live a ___ (1) ___ life. We can save water by ___ (2) ___ off the tap while brushing teeth. We should also ___ (3) ___ more trees and flowers. Using public transport ___ (4) ___ (help) reduce air pollution. Remember that every small step ___ (5) ___ (make) a difference. Let's act ___ (6) ___ (quick) before it's too late.

questions.analysis: 环保语境'绿色生活'，green life 为常见搭配。
by + doing，turn off 关掉。
plant trees 种树，should 后接动词原形。
主语 using public transport 单数，一般现在时动词用 helps。
主语 every small step 单数，动词用 makes。
修饰动词 act 用副词，quick→quickly。

sections.name: 阅读与回答问题
sections.passage: Robots are becoming part of our life. In some hospitals, robots help carry medicine to patients. In restaurants, robot waiters can take orders and serve food. A robot named 'Xiaoyi' can even talk with old people and remind them to take medicine. Scientists say robots will do more housework in the future, but they will never replace human love and care.

questions.stem: Where do some robots help carry medicine?
questions.analysis: 细节定位第二句。

questions.stem: What can robot waiters do?
questions.answer: They can take orders and serve food.
questions.analysis: 细节第三句。

questions.stem: What can 'Xiaoyi' do for old people?
questions.answer: It can talk with them and remind them to take medicine.
questions.analysis: 细节第四句。

questions.stem: What can robots never replace according to scientists?
questions.analysis: 末句直接点明。

sections.name: 书面表达
sections.prompt: 随着 AI 工具普及，请你给校报写一篇短文，谈谈中学生应如何合理使用 AI（如用于查资料、练口语，但不抄袭、不依赖）。
sections.referenceOutline: 第一段：AI 无处不在，应明智使用；第二段：正面用法（查资料、练口语）+ 反面禁忌（不抄答案、不依赖）；第三段：做 AI 的主人。
sections.referenceVersion: With AI tools everywhere, we students should use them wisely. First, we can use AI to look up information and practice spoken English. It saves time and helps us learn. However, we must not copy answers or let AI do our homework. AI is a helpful tool, not our brain. Only by thinking by ourselves can we really improve. Let's be the master of AI!
sections.analysis: 评分要点：立场明确（合理使用）、正反对比、连接词 however/only by；常见失分：通篇只夸 AI、缺少'不依赖'的约束、词数不足。

papers.title: 南通市中考英语模拟试卷（三）
papers.structureNote: 按2025南通改革结构精简：覆盖全部7大题型。

questions.stem: Look! The boys ___ basketball on the playground.
questions.analysis: 考查现在进行时。Look! 提示动作正在发生，用 am/is/are + doing。

questions.stem: I ___ TV when you called me last night.
questions.analysis: 考查过去进行时。call 为过去瞬间动作，看电视是当时正在进行的动作，用 was/were + doing。

questions.stem: By the time we got to the station, the train ___ already.
questions.analysis: 考查过去完成时。'到达'是过去动作，'离开'发生在到达之前（过去的过去），用 had + done。

questions.stem: He went to the library ___ some books.
questions.analysis: 考查非谓语动词。不定式 to read 表目的'去图书馆为了读书'。

questions.stem: ___ beautiful the music is! I enjoy it very much.
questions.analysis: 考查感叹句。How + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语！beautiful 为形容词，用 How。

questions.stem: The book is shared ___ the students in our class.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。三者及以上'在…之间'用 among；between 用于两者。

questions.stem: —___ book is this? —It's Lily's.
questions.analysis: 考查疑问词。答语 Lily's 表所属，用 Whose（谁的）。

questions.stem: Tom is ___ tall ___ his father.
questions.analysis: 考查原级比较。as + 原级 + as 表示'和…一样'。

questions.stem: —I'm sorry I broke your cup. —___
questions.analysis: 考查情景交际。回应道歉用 Never mind（没关系）；You're welcome 回应感谢。

questions.stem: Don't ___ today's work till tomorrow. Do it now.
questions.analysis: 考查动词短语。put off 意为'推迟'，符合'别把今天的事拖到明天'。

sections.name: 完形填空
sections.passage: I still remember my first day in the new school. I was shy and had no ___ (1) ___. A boy named Tom came to me and ___ (2) ___ a smile. He showed me around and we became good ___ (3) ___. One day, I failed a math test and felt ___ (4) ___. Tom didn't laugh; instead, he helped me with the problems ___ (5) ___. With his help, I made ___ (6) ___ little by little. Now I know a true friend is someone who stays with you in ___ (7) ___ times. I feel lucky to have such a ___ (8) ___.

questions.analysis: 新学校'没有朋友'符合 shy（害羞）的语境。
wear a smile 为固定表达，意为'面带微笑'。
前文相识并成为'好朋友'，friends 符合。
考试失利自然感到'sad（难过）'。
朋友'耐心地'讲题，patiently 体现品质。
make progress 固定搭配，意为'取得进步'。
in hard times 意为'在艰难时刻'，与 true friend 呼应。
全文讲友谊，结尾呼应'such a friend（这样的朋友）'。

passages.title: School Volunteer Program
passages.body:
Join the School Volunteer Program!
● Who: Students aged 12–15.
● What: Help in the library, clean the school garden, or visit the community center.
● When: Every Saturday 9:00–11:00 a.m.
● Why: Learn to care for others and get a service certificate.
● How: Talk to your class teacher before this Friday.
Be a helper, be a star!

questions.stem: Who can join the program?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Who 一行写明 12–15 岁学生。

questions.stem: When does the program take place?
questions.analysis: 细节题。When 一行写明每周六上午 9–11 点。

questions.stem: What can volunteers get at last?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Why 一行提到可获得 service certificate。

passages.title: Mom's Little Notebook
passages.body: My mother is busy, but she always leaves me a small notebook on my desk. In it, she writes encouraging words like 'Believe in yourself' and 'Have a nice day'. When I feel tired after study, I read them and smile. One day I asked why she did it. She said, 'Words are small, but they can warm a heart.' Now I also write little notes for her. We share love through these words.

questions.stem: What does the mother leave on the desk?
options: B. A small notebook with words
questions.analysis: 细节题。首段说明母亲留'小笔记本'并写鼓励的话。

questions.stem: How does the writer feel after reading the notes?
questions.analysis: 细节/推理题。'I read them and smile'及'warm a heart'体现温暖开心。

questions.stem: What is the best title?
options: B. Words That Warm a Heart
questions.analysis: 主旨题。全文围绕'母亲用文字温暖我心'展开，B 最贴切。

passages.title: Healthy Study Habits
passages.body:
Good study habits help you learn better.
____(1)____ A quiet place helps you focus on books.
____(2)____ Break big tasks into small ones and do a little each day.
____(3)____ Reading aloud or teaching others makes memory stronger.
____(4)____ A short break after an hour of study keeps your mind fresh.
____(5)____ Healthy food and enough sleep give your brain power.
options: A. Find a quiet place to study.

questions.stem: 空白 (1) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'安静的地方有助于专注'对应'找安静处学习'，A 为段落主旨。

questions.stem: 空白 (2) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'把大任务拆小、每天做一点'对应'明智规划时间'，B 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (3) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'朗读或教别人强化记忆'对应'主动复习'，C 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (4) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'学习一小时后的短休息'对应'常休息'，D 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (5) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'健康饮食与充足睡眠'对应'保持健康身体'，E 匹配；F 为干扰项。

questions.stem: The teacher asked us ___ (not talk) in class.
questions.analysis: ask sb. (not) to do sth. 固定结构，用 not to talk。

questions.stem: My friend ___ (be) in the art club for two years.
questions.analysis: for two years 为延续性时间，用现在完成时 has been。

questions.stem: This is the ___ (excite) match I have ever watched.
questions.analysis: the + 最高级，exciting 多音节词最高级为 most exciting。

questions.stem: He ran ___ (fast) than any other student in his class.
questions.analysis: than 前用比较级，fast 的比较级为 faster。

questions.stem: We should listen to our parents ___ (careful).
questions.analysis: 修饰动词 listen 用副词 carefully。

questions.stem: The ___ (friend) between us will last forever.
questions.analysis: 定冠词后接名词，friend→friendship（友谊）。

sections.name: 短文填空
sections.passage: Our school held a volunteer day last week. Students went to the park to ___ (1) ___ litter and planted flowers. Some visited the old people's home to ___ (2) ___ them clean the rooms. I joined a team to teach little ___ (3) ___ (kid) to read. We were tired but ___ (4) ___ (happy). Helping others makes us feel ___ (5) ___ (use) and brings us ___ (6) ___ (much) joy than we give.

questions.analysis: collect litter 意为'捡垃圾'，志愿者活动常见表达。
help sb. (to) do，意为'帮他们打扫房间'。
little 后接名词，kid 用复数 kids 表'小孩子们'。
but 转折，'累但开心'，用形容词 happy 作表语。
feel + adj.，use→useful（有用的），感到'被需要'。
than 前用比较级，much 的比较级为 more。

sections.name: 阅读与回答问题
sections.passage: Zhang Lei moved to a new city last year. At first he felt lonely because he knew nobody. His neighbor, an old man, often invited him to play chess. They became good friends. The old man told Zhang Lei, 'A kind neighbor is better than a distant relative.' Now Zhang Lei says making friends needs an open heart.

questions.stem: Why did Zhang Lei feel lonely at first?
questions.analysis: 细节定位第二句。

questions.stem: Who became his friend?
questions.analysis: 细节第三、四句。

questions.stem: What did they do together?
questions.analysis: 细节第三句。

questions.stem: What does Zhang Lei learn about making friends?
questions.analysis: 末句点明主旨。

sections.name: 书面表达
sections.prompt: 你的好朋友李雷即将转学，请你写一封英文信向他表达感谢与祝福（回忆一件你们共同的难忘小事，并祝他前程似锦）。
sections.referenceOutline: 开头问候+说明写信目的；正文回忆一件共同小事（如一起准备比赛/互相帮助）；结尾表达感谢与祝福。
sections.referenceVersion: Dear Li Lei, I heard you are moving to another city. I feel sad but want to say thank you. Do you remember the sports day when I fell and you helped me up? That moment showed me true friendship. You are the best friend I ever had. I will miss our time together. Wish you a bright future and happiness everywhere! Keep in touch. Yours, Zhang Wei
sections.analysis: 评分要点：书信格式、回忆具体小事、情感真挚、连接词使用；常见失分：流水账无细节、语法错误多、未表达祝福。

papers.title: 南通市中考英语模拟试卷（四）
papers.structureNote: 按2025南通改革结构精简：覆盖全部7大题型。

questions.stem: The little girl ___ play the erhu very well at the age of six.
questions.analysis: 考查情态动词。表示'能够'用 can；此处指小女孩有演奏能力。

questions.stem: The letter ___ by him yesterday evening.
questions.analysis: 考查被动语态。letter 与 write 为被动关系，yesterday 用一般过去时被动 was written。

questions.stem: The village ___ I was born is now a beautiful town.
questions.analysis: 考查定语从句。先行词 village 表地点，关系副词用 where。

questions.stem: His mother made him ___ his room every weekend.
questions.analysis: 考查非谓语动词。make sb. do sth. 用省略 to 的不定式。

questions.stem: ___ it rained heavily, they still went to the match.
questions.analysis: 考查连词。前后为让步关系（雨大仍去），用 Although。

questions.stem: Please cut the apple ___ a sharp knife.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。表示'用工具'用 with。

questions.stem: This book is ___ interesting than that one, I think.
questions.analysis: 考查比较级。than 前用比较级，little 的比较级为 less（修饰多音节interesting 用 less）。

questions.stem: —How long can I ___ the book? —For two weeks.
questions.analysis: 考查动词辨析。borrow/lend 为瞬间动词，不能与 how long 连用；keep 表持续'借'。

questions.stem: —Would you like to visit the museum with us? —___
questions.analysis: 考查情景交际。回应邀请用 Yes, I'd love to。

questions.stem: ___ of the two answers is right, so we must check again.
questions.analysis: 考查代词。of the two 限定两者，'都不正确'用 neither。

sections.name: 完形填空
sections.passage: Mei is a young embroiderer. She learned the skill from her grandma at the age of eight. At first, it was ___ (1) ___ for her little fingers to hold the needle. Her works were not ___ (2) ___, and some people even laughed. But she didn't ___ (3) ___. She practiced for hours every day. Slowly, her skills ___ (4) ___. Years later, her embroidery won prizes and was ___ (5) ___ in a museum. Now she teaches young people so that this art will not ___ (6) ___. She says, 'Tradition is not old; it is a ___ (7) ___ that connects us to our roots.' Her story ___ (8) ___ many students to love traditional culture.

questions.analysis: 小孩手指拿针'困难'，hard 符合语境。
初期作品不'完美'，perfect 与后文'有人笑'呼应。
前文遇挫，但她没'放弃'，give up 符合。
长期练习后技艺'提高'，improved 符合。
作品在博物馆被'展出'，shown 符合。
传承的目的是不让艺术'消失'，disappear 符合。
传统是连接根脉的'桥梁'，bridge 比喻贴切。
她的故事'鼓励'学生热爱传统，encourages 符合。

passages.title: Intangible Cultural Heritage Experience Day
passages.body:
Join us for Intangible Cultural Heritage Experience Day!
● Time: Saturday, June 14, 9:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
● Place: City Art Center, Hall 3.

Only 100 seats! Don't miss it.

questions.stem: When is the experience day?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Time 一行写明 6 月 14 日。

questions.stem: What can visitors do there?
options: B. Try paper-cutting and make clay figures
questions.analysis: 细节题。Activities 列出剪纸、做泥人、看皮影。

questions.stem: How should people book a seat?
options: B. Scan the QR code before June 10
questions.analysis: 细节题。Book 一行写明 6 月 10 日前扫码预约。

passages.title: The Tree Planter
passages.body: Mr. Li, a 65-year-old farmer, has planted trees on the hill near his village for 30 years. When he started, the hill was bare and the wind blew the soil away. He carried water up the hill every day and planted saplings with his own hands. Many villagers thought he was wasting time. But he kept going. Today, the hill is green, birds sing in the trees, and the soil stays put. 'Trees are the lungs of the earth,' he says with a smile. His simple act changed the land and inspired the whole village to protect nature.

questions.stem: Why did Mr. Li plant trees?
options: B. To stop soil from blowing away
questions.analysis: 细节/推理题。荒山'风把土吹走'，种树为防止水土流失。

questions.stem: What do we know about the villagers at first?
options: B. They thought he wasted time
questions.analysis: 细节题。'Many villagers thought he was wasting time.'

questions.stem: What is the best title?
options: B. The Lungs of the Earth
C. A Man Who Greened a Hill
questions.analysis: 主旨题。全文讲老人 30 年绿化荒山，C 最贴切。

passages.title: How to Protect Traditional Culture
passages.body:
Traditional culture is our treasure. Here is how we can keep it alive.
____(1)____ Visit museums and learn the stories behind old objects.
____(2)____ Try paper-cutting, calligraphy or local food with your family.
____(3)____ Share photos and short videos of traditional skills on social media.
____(4)____ Young people can learn from masters and pass them on.
____(5)____ When more people join, the culture will shine again.

questions.stem: 空白 (1) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'参观博物馆、了解老物件背后的故事'对应'了解过去'，A 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (2) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'动手尝试剪纸、书法、地方美食'对应'体验式传承'，B 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (3) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'在社交媒体分享'对应'线上传播'，C 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (4) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'年轻人向大师学习并传承'对应'培养下一代'，D 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (5) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'更多人参与，文化重新发光'对应'共同努力'，E 匹配；F 为干扰项。

questions.stem: He spent two hours ___ (finish) the picture.
questions.analysis: spend ... (in) doing，用动名词 finishing。

questions.stem: The story is so ___ (move) that we all cried.
questions.analysis: 修饰事用 -ing 形容词 moving（令人感动的）。

questions.stem: She is one of the ___ (good) dancers in our school.
questions.analysis: one of + the + 最高级，good 最高级为 best。

questions.stem: They ___ (success) held the show last week.
questions.analysis: 修饰动词 held 用副词 successfully。

questions.stem: We should protect ___ (tradition) culture.
questions.analysis: 修饰名词 culture 用形容词 traditional（传统的）。

questions.stem: It took them three days ___ (complete) the work.
questions.analysis: It takes sb. some time to do 固定句型，用不定式。

sections.name: 短文填空
sections.passage: Wang is a master of wood carving. He started to learn it when he was a ___ (1) ___ (young) boy. His teacher was very ___ (2) ___ (strict) with him. At that time, few young people were ___ (3) ___ (interest) in the old skill. But Wang never stopped. Now his works are ___ (4) ___ (sell) all over the world. He believes art can bring people ___ (5) ___ (happy). He also trains students so that the skill will be kept ___ (6) ___ (live).

questions.analysis: a young boy 为固定表达，young 无需变形。
be strict with 固定搭配'对…严格'，strict 无需变形。
be interested in 固定搭配'对…感兴趣'。
works 与 sell 为被动，are sold（被销售）。
bring sb. + 名词，happy→happiness（幸福）。
keep + 宾语 + 形容词，live→alive（保持活力/存续）。

sections.name: 阅读与回答问题
sections.passage: Chen Zhen is a 70-year-old paper-cut artist. She has made paper-cuts for over 50 years. Every spring, she teaches children in her village for free. 'I want the red paper to bring joy to more people,' she says. Her works show birds, flowers and folk stories. Many schools now invite her to give lessons.

questions.stem: How long has Chen Zhen made paper-cuts?
questions.analysis: 细节定位第二句。

questions.stem: Who does she teach in spring?
questions.analysis: 细节第三句。

questions.stem: What do her works show?
questions.analysis: 细节第四句。

questions.stem: Why does she teach for free?
questions.answer: Because she wants the red paper to bring joy to more people.
questions.analysis: 直接引用人物话语。

sections.name: 书面表达
sections.prompt: 你们学校将举办“传统文化周”，请你用英文写一篇短文介绍一项中国传统手艺（如剪纸、书法或刺绣），说明其特点与意义。
requirements: 包含手艺名称、特点与意义
sections.referenceOutline: 第一段：点明手艺名称；第二段：特点（如用料、图案、传承）；第三段：文化意义（连接传统、带来美感）。
sections.referenceVersion: Paper-cutting is a traditional Chinese art with a history of over 1,500 years. Artists use red paper and scissors to make flowers, birds and characters. It is often seen on windows during the Spring Festival, bringing good luck. I think this art is beautiful and meaningful. It connects us to our culture and shows the wisdom of Chinese people. We should learn and pass it on.
sections.analysis: 评分要点：手艺名称明确、特点具体、点出文化意义、连接词使用；常见失分：泛泛而谈无细节、时态混乱、词数不足。

papers.title: 南通市中考英语模拟试卷（五）
papers.structureNote: 按2025南通改革结构精简：覆盖全部7大题型。

questions.stem: I have ___ finished my homework, so I can watch TV now.
questions.analysis: 考查现在完成时副词。肯定句表'已经'用 already；yet 用于否定/疑问句。

questions.stem: You ___ eat too much junk food; it's bad for you.
questions.analysis: 考查情态动词。'不该吃太多垃圾食品'用 shouldn't。

questions.stem: He got up early ___ catch the first bus to school.
questions.analysis: 考查非谓语动词。in order to + 动词原形表目的'为了赶上'。

questions.stem: He has lived in this city ___ five years.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。for + 时间段，与现在完成时连用。

questions.stem: The doctor ___ saved the boy's life is very kind.
questions.analysis: 考查定语从句。先行词 doctor 指人，在从句作主语用 who。

questions.stem: My father often ___ with me about my school life.
questions.analysis: 考查动词辨析。talk with sb. 为固定搭配，意为'与…交谈'。

questions.stem: The ___ you exercise, the healthier you will be.
questions.analysis: 考查比较级。the + 比较级 …, the + 比较级 … 结构，'越多…越…'。

questions.stem: The window ___ by the strong wind yesterday.
questions.analysis: 考查被动语态。window 与 break 为被动，yesterday 用一般过去时被动。

questions.stem: —Why not take a walk after dinner? —___
questions.analysis: 考查情景交际。Why not …? 提建议，回应用 Good idea。

questions.stem: ___ of the students passed the PE test because they trained hard.
questions.analysis: 考查代词。students 为三者以上，'全部通过'用 all。

sections.name: 完形填空
sections.passage: Two years ago, I was weak and often ill. My doctor said I needed more ___ (1) ___. At first, running was hard and I wanted to ___ (2) ___. But my friend Li Hua ran with me and ___ (3) ___ me on. We ran three times a week. After a few months, I felt ___ (4) ___ and had more energy. Now I ___ (5) ___ running and even joined the school team. Exercise not only builds the ___ (6) ___ but also clears the mind. I learn that ___ (7) ___ is the key to a healthy life. I will ___ (8) ___ this good habit.

questions.analysis: 医生针对'虚弱多病'建议多'锻炼'，exercise 符合。
跑步难自然想'放弃'，give up 符合。
cheer sb. on 为固定搭配，意为'为…加油'。
锻炼后感到'更强壮'，stronger 符合。
现在'享受'跑步并加入校队，enjoy 符合。
运动强健'身体'，body 符合。
全文讲坚持锻炼，'坚持'是健康生活的关键，persistence 符合。
keep a habit 固定搭配'保持习惯'。

passages.title: School Health Week
passages.body:
School Health Week is coming!
● Date: September 20–26.
● Activities: Morning run, fruit party, sleep-talk show, sports meeting.
● Goal: Help students build healthy habits.
● How to join: Sign your name on the list in the classroom.

questions.stem: When is the School Health Week?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Date 一行写明 9 月 20–26 日。

questions.stem: Which activity is NOT mentioned?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Activities 列出晨跑、水果派对、睡眠讲座、运动会，未提歌唱比赛。

questions.stem: What prize will the best class get?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Prize 一行写明篮球。

passages.title: The Price of Lost Sleep
passages.body: Last term, Mike stayed up late every night playing games. He slept only five hours. In class, he often fell asleep and got low marks. His teacher talked with him and his parents made a rule: no phones after 9 p.m. Mike began to sleep eight hours. Soon he felt fresh, listened carefully, and his grades went up. He said, 'I never knew sleep could change my life so much.'

questions.stem: What did Mike use to do at night?
questions.analysis: 细节题。首句'stayed up late every night playing games'。

questions.stem: What happened to him in class?
questions.analysis: 细节题。'In class, he often fell asleep and got low marks.'

questions.stem: What changed Mike's life?
questions.analysis: 推理题。充足睡眠后状态与成绩改善，点明主题。

passages.title: Build Healthy Habits
passages.body:
Good habits keep us strong. Here are some tips.
____(1)____ Go to bed and wake up at the same time every day.
____(2)____ Eat more vegetables and less sugar; drink enough water.
____(3)____ Walk, run or play ball games for at least an hour a day.
____(4)____ Put down the phone and read a book before bed.
____(5)____ A healthy mind lives in a healthy body.
options: A. Keep a regular sleep schedule.

questions.stem: 空白 (1) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'每天同一时间睡醒'对应'规律作息'，A 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (2) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'多吃蔬菜少糖、多喝水'对应'均衡饮食'，B 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (3) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'每天运动至少一小时'对应'每日锻炼'，C 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (4) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'睡前放下手机读书'对应'睡前放松'，D 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (5) 应选

questions.stem: Eating ___ (regular) is good for your stomach.
questions.analysis: 修饰动名词 eating 用副词 regularly。

questions.stem: He looks ___ (health) and happy after the trip.
questions.analysis: look + adj.，health→healthy（健康的）。

questions.stem: The ___ (ill) made him stay in bed for a week.
questions.analysis: 定冠词后接名词，ill→illness（疾病）。

questions.stem: She exercises ___ (two) a week.
questions.analysis: 表示'一周两次'用 twice。

questions.stem: It's ___ (help) to take a walk after dinner.
questions.analysis: It's + adj.，help→helpful（有帮助的）。

questions.stem: He was too ___ (sleep) to do his homework.
questions.analysis: too + adj. + to，sleep→sleepy（困倦的）。

sections.name: 短文填空
sections.passage: Good habits keep us ___ (1) ___ (health). We should go to bed early and get up ___ (2) ___ (early). A balanced diet means eating more vegetables and ___ (3) ___ (little) meat. ___ (4) ___ (wash) hands before meals stops germs. Also, a ___ (5) ___ (smile) face helps you make friends. Remember: an apple a day ___ (6) ___ (keep) the doctor away.

questions.analysis: keep + sb. + adj.，health→healthy。
get up early 固定表达'早起'，early 原形。
与 more 对应，little 比较级为 less（更少肉）。
动名词作主语，wash→Washing。
修饰 face 用现在分词 smiling（微笑的）。
主语 an apple 单数，一般现在时动词用 keeps。

sections.name: 阅读与回答问题
sections.passage: Teenagers need about eight to nine hours of sleep each night. But many students stay up late playing games or doing homework. Lack of sleep makes them tired and unable to focus in class. A study shows that good sleep helps memory and mood. Experts advise turning off phones before bed and keeping a regular schedule.

questions.stem: How many hours of sleep do teenagers need?
questions.analysis: 细节定位首句。

questions.stem: Why do many students stay up late?
questions.analysis: 细节第二句。

questions.stem: What does lack of sleep cause?
questions.analysis: 细节第三句。

questions.stem: What do experts advise?
questions.answer: Turn off phones before bed and keep a regular schedule.
questions.analysis: 末句直接建议。

sections.name: 书面表达
sections.prompt: 假如你是李华，你的同学 Tom 总熬夜打游戏、精神不好。请你写一封英文信，给他提出保持健康的三条建议。
requirements: 给出具体可操作的建议
sections.referenceOutline: 开头关心近况；三条建议（规律作息/健康饮食/适度运动）；结尾鼓励。
sections.referenceVersion: Dear Tom, I notice you look tired these days. I'm worried about your health. Here is my advice. First, go to bed before 10 p.m. and sleep eight hours. Second, eat more vegetables and less junk food. Third, do some sports every day instead of playing games all night. A healthy body helps you study better. Hope you feel better soon! Yours, Li Hua
sections.analysis: 评分要点：三条建议具体、使用 first/second/third 连接、语气友善；常见失分：建议空泛、语法错误、未用连接词。

papers.title: 南通市中考英语模拟试卷（六）
papers.theme: 旅游文化·丝路与跨文化交流
papers.structureNote: 按2025南通改革结构精简：覆盖全部7大题型。

questions.stem: We ___ to the Great Wall and took many photos last summer.
questions.analysis: 考查一般过去时。last summer 表过去，动词用过去式 went。

questions.stem: Look at the dark clouds. It ___ rain soon.
questions.analysis: 考查一般将来时。根据迹象'乌云'判断'即将下雨'，用 be going to。

questions.stem: You ___ obey the traffic rules when you cross the road.
questions.analysis: 考查情态动词。交通规则是强制的，用 must（必须）。

questions.stem: Would you mind ___ the window? It's a bit hot.
questions.analysis: 考查非谓语动词。mind 后接动名词 doing，用 opening。

questions.stem: He studied hard ___ he could pass the entrance exam.
questions.analysis: 考查连词。'努力学习'的目的是'通过考试'，用 so that 引导目的状语从句。

questions.stem: He improved his English ___ reading English novels aloud.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。表示'通过某种方式'用 by。

questions.stem: This math problem is ___ more difficult than that one.
questions.analysis: 考查比较级修饰语。even 可修饰比较级，表'甚至更…'；very/too/quite 不修饰比较级。

questions.stem: I ___ a strange noise outside my window last night.
questions.analysis: 考查动词辨析。hear 强调'听到'的结果；listen 强调'听'的动作。

questions.stem: —Could you say that again, please? —___
questions.analysis: 考查情景交际。回应'请再说一遍'，用 Sure（当然可以）。

questions.stem: The book on my desk is mine, and ___ on the chair is yours.
questions.analysis: 考查代词。the one 指代同类单数可数名词（the book on the chair），表特指。

sections.name: 完形填空
sections.passage: Last summer, I joined a study trip along the Silk Road. We visited old cities and saw ___ (1) ___ we had only read about in books. The guide told us how traders used camels to carry silk and ___ (2) ___ across the desert. I was ___ (3) ___ by the stories of brave travelers. At Dunhuang, we saw beautiful paintings on the cave ___ (4) ___. The trip taught me that different cultures can ___ (5) ___ and learn from each other. It also made me ___ (6) ___ how big and colorful our world is. I took many photos to ___ (7) ___ the memory. This journey was not just a trip, but a lesson about ___ (8) ___.

questions.analysis: 看到书里读过的'地方'，places 符合语境。
丝绸之路商人用骆驼运丝绸与'香料'，spices 符合历史。
被勇敢旅人的故事'感动'，moved 符合。
敦煌莫高窟'壁画'在洞窟墙壁上，walls 符合。
不同文化能'相遇'并互相学习，meet 符合。
旅程让我'意识到'世界的广阔，realize 符合。
拍照以'保留'记忆，keep the memory 符合。
全文讲丝路文化交流，'关于文化的课'点题，culture 符合。

passages.title: Museum Study Trip Notice
passages.body:
Museum Study Trip for Grade 8
● Date: October 18 (Friday)
● Time: 8:30 a.m. – 3:30 p.m.
● Place: Nantong Museum
● What to do: Listen to a guide, see old coins and silk, write a report.
● Bring: Notebook, lunch, student card.
● Rule: No photos inside the showroom.
Meet at the school gate at 8:00 a.m.

questions.stem: When will the trip start?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Date 一行写明 10 月 18 日（周五）。

questions.stem: What can students see there?
questions.analysis: 细节题。What to do 提到看古币与丝绸。

questions.stem: Which rule must students follow?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Rule 一行写明展厅内禁止拍照。

passages.title: A Friend from Canada
passages.body: Emma came from Canada to study in our school for a term. At first she knew little Chinese, so I helped her with daily life. In return, she taught me English slang and shared stories of maple leaves and ice hockey. One weekend, she tried making dumplings at my home; hers looked funny but tasted good. We laughed a lot. Now we are best friends. She says China feels like a second home, and I say Canada is on my travel list.

questions.stem: Why did the writer help Emma at first?
questions.analysis: 细节题。首段'knew little Chinese'说明需要帮助。

questions.stem: What did Emma teach the writer?
options: B. English slang and her country's stories
questions.analysis: 细节题。'she taught me English slang and shared stories'。

questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.analysis: 主旨题。全文讲跨国友谊，B 最贴切。

passages.title: Be a Good Traveler
passages.body:
Travel is fun, but we should be responsible.
____(1)____ Learn a few words of the local language and read about its history.
____(2)____ Throw rubbish in bins and never carve on walls.
____(3)____ Buy hand-made things from local people to help their life.
____(4)____ Listen to others and respect different ways of living.
____(5)____ A good traveler leaves only footprints and takes only memories.

questions.stem: 空白 (1) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'出发前学当地语言、读历史'对应'行前了解'，A 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (2) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'垃圾入箱、不刻墙'对应'保护环境'，B 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (3) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'向当地人买手作以帮助其生活'对应'支持当地人'，C 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (4) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'尊重不同生活方式'对应'尊重差异'，D 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (5) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'只留脚印、只带回忆'升华责任旅行，E（善待动物/自然）最贴近；F 为干扰项。

questions.stem: We ___ (take) a trip to Xi'an next month.
questions.analysis: next month 表将来，用一般将来时 will take。

questions.stem: The story is ___ (true) moving and everyone cried.
questions.analysis: 修饰形容词 moving 用副词 truly（真正地）。

questions.stem: They showed us some ___ (tradition) clothes of their tribe.
questions.analysis: 修饰名词 clothes 用形容词 traditional。

questions.stem: I have never ___ (see) such a big museum before.
questions.analysis: 现在完成时 have + 过去分词，see→seen。

questions.stem: The guide spoke ___ (clear) so we all understood.
questions.analysis: 修饰动词 spoke 用副词 clearly。

questions.stem: It is important ___ (respect) local customs when traveling.
questions.analysis: It is + adj. + to do，用不定式。

sections.name: 短文填空
sections.passage: Travel opens our eyes. When we visit a new place, we should learn about its ___ (1) ___ (culture) first. It is polite ___ (2) ___ (say) hello in the local way. We must also protect the ___ (3) ___ (environment) and not leave rubbish. A good traveler listens ___ (4) ___ (much) than he speaks. By meeting different people, we learn that we are all ___ (5) ___ (member) of one big family. Travel makes life ___ (6) ___ (color).

questions.analysis: learn about its culture 了解当地文化，culture 不可数。
It is + adj. + to do，用不定式 to say。
protect the environment 保护环境，名词原级。
than 前用比较级，much→more。
all 后接复数，member→members。
make + 宾语 + adj.，color→colorful（多彩的）。

sections.name: 阅读与回答问题
sections.passage: The Silk Road was a network of trade routes over 2,000 years ago. It connected China with Central Asia, the Middle East and Europe. Silk, tea and porcelain went west, while horses, fruit and ideas came east. Beyond goods, it spread science, art and religion. Today, the Belt and Road Initiative brings people closer again.

questions.stem: How old is the Silk Road?
questions.analysis: 细节定位首句。

questions.stem: What went west from China?
questions.analysis: 细节第三句。

questions.stem: What came east to China?
questions.analysis: 细节第三句后半。

questions.stem: What does the Belt and Road Initiative do today?
questions.analysis: 末句直接点明。

sections.name: 书面表达
sections.prompt: 你刚结束一次研学旅行，请你给英国笔友 Amy 写一封邮件，介绍你参观的一处中国景点（如博物馆、古城或名胜），并谈谈你的收获。
requirements: 包含景点名称与一处见闻
sections.referenceOutline: 开头问候+说明旅行；正文介绍景点与见闻；结尾谈收获（了解历史/文化）。
sections.referenceVersion: Dear Amy, I just finished a study trip to the Nantong Museum. It was amazing! I saw old coins, silk clothes and paintings from hundreds of years ago. The guide told us stories about traders on the Silk Road. I learned a lot about Chinese history and felt proud of our culture. I hope to visit more places like this. What about your trips? Yours, Li Hua
sections.analysis: 评分要点：景点名称具体、有真实见闻细节、结尾点明收获、连接词；常见失分：空泛无细节、时态混乱、词数不足。

papers.title: 南通市中考英语模拟试卷（七）
papers.structureNote: 按2025南通改革结构精简：覆盖全部7大题型。

questions.stem: She has taught in this school ___ 2015.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。since + 过去时间点（2015），与现在完成时连用。

questions.stem: The bridge ___ in 1990 and is still in use.
questions.analysis: 考查被动语态。bridge 与 build 为被动，1990 用一般过去时被动 was built。

questions.stem: The boy ___ be the thief; he was at home at that time.
questions.analysis: 考查情态动词表推测。'当时在家'说明'不可能是小偷'，否定推测用 can't。

questions.stem: We went to the zoo ___ the pandas yesterday.
questions.analysis: 考查非谓语动词。不定式 to see 表目的'去看熊猫'。

questions.stem: He was late ___ he missed the early bus.
questions.analysis: 考查连词。'错过早班车'是迟到的原因，用 because。

questions.stem: I'm worried ___ the coming math exam.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。be worried about 为固定搭配，意为'担心…'。

questions.stem: This elephant is ___ heavy ___ that one.
questions.analysis: 考查原级比较。as + 原级 + as 表示'和…一样重'。

questions.stem: The sun ___ in the east and sets in the west.
questions.analysis: 考查动词辨析。rise 为不及物'升起'；raise 为及物'举起'。太阳'升起'用 rises。

questions.stem: —I failed the English test again. —___! Try harder next time.
questions.analysis: 考查情景交际。安慰失利者用 Cheer up（振作起来）。

questions.stem: There is ___ milk in the glass, so I need to buy some.
questions.analysis: 考查代词。milk 不可数，'几乎没有'用 little（表否定）。

sections.name: 完形填空
sections.passage: Last spring, my classmates and I joined a project to protect ___ (1) ___ birds in the wetland. We put up signs to tell people not to ___ (2) ___ the eggs. One day, we found a baby bird that had fallen from its ___ (3) ___. It looked weak, so we took it to a care center. The workers fed it and kept it ___ (4) ___. After two weeks, it was strong enough to ___ (5) ___. We returned it to the wild with joy. This experience taught me that every small life ___ (6) ___ and we should ___ (7) ___ nature. I hope more people will ___ (8) ___ us.

questions.analysis: 保护'野生'鸟类，wild 符合湿地语境。
立牌提醒不要'触碰'鸟蛋，touch 符合。
小鸟从'巢'中掉下，nest 符合。
救助中心喂它并保暖，kept it warm 符合。
小鸟康复后'飞'回野外，fly 符合。
每个小生命都'重要'，matters 符合。
应当'保护'自然，protect 符合主题。
希望更多人'跟随/加入'我们，follow 在此意为'效仿行动'。

passages.title: Wetland Park Visiting Rules
passages.body:
Welcome to the Wetland Park!
● Open: 8:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m., Tuesday to Sunday.
● Ticket: Free for students with school ID.
● Rules: Stay on the path; do not feed the birds; keep quiet.
● Activity: Free bird-watching tour at 9:00 a.m. every Saturday.
● Hotline: 0513-12345678.
Enjoy nature, but please protect it.

questions.stem: When is the park closed?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Open 写明周二至周日，故周一闭园。

questions.stem: What can students do for free?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Ticket 写明学生凭校牌免费入园。

questions.stem: What is NOT allowed?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Rules 明确'do not feed the birds'。

passages.title: My Friend, the Guide Dog
passages.body: Xiao Ming is blind. His best friend is a guide dog named Lele. Every morning, Lele leads him to school safely, stopping at red lights and avoiding crowds. At school, Lele waits quietly beside his desk. Once, Lele pulled Xiao Ming back from a speeding bicycle—it may have saved his life. Xiao Ming says, 'Lele is not just a dog; he is my eyes and my family.' Their story shows the deep bond between humans and animals.

questions.stem: What does Lele do for Xiao Ming?
options: B. Leads him and keeps him safe
questions.analysis: 细节题。首段说明导盲犬引路、避车流、保安全。

questions.stem: What happened once on the road?
options: A. Lele saved him from a bicycle
D. Lele barked at a teacher
questions.analysis: 细节题。'pulled Xiao Ming back from a speeding bicycle' 体现救主。

questions.stem: What does the story show?
options: B. Deep bond between humans and animals
questions.analysis: 主旨题。末句点明人与动物的深厚纽带。

passages.title: How to Protect Wild Animals
passages.body:
Wild animals are our friends, but many are in danger.
____(1)____ Learn about endangered species and tell others their stories.
____(2)____ Never buy things made from wild animal parts.
____(3)____ Join a local group to plant trees or clean rivers.
____(4)____ Do not litter, and say no to illegal hunting.
____(5)____ Small acts by many people can save a species.

questions.stem: 空白 (1) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'了解濒危物种并告诉他人'对应'传播信息'，A 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (2) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'不买野生动物制品'对应'拒绝非法产品'，B 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (3) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'参加植树、清河活动'对应'参与活动'，C 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (4) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'不乱扔垃圾、反对非法狩猎'对应'保护家园/栖息地'，D 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (5) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'众人的微小行动能拯救物种'对应'每分努力都重要'，E 匹配；F 为干扰项。

questions.stem: We should stop ___ (cut) down trees in the forest.
questions.analysis: stop doing 指'停止正在做的事'，用 cutting。

questions.stem: The panda is a(n) ___ (danger) animal, so we must save it.
questions.analysis: 修饰 animal 用形容词 endangered（濒危的）。

questions.stem: The keeper fed the little dog ___ (careful).
questions.analysis: 修饰动词 fed 用副词 carefully。

questions.stem: More trees ___ (plant) by the students last spring.
questions.analysis: trees 与 plant 被动，last spring 用一般过去时被动 were planted。

questions.stem: The ___ (lose) of forests worries many scientists.
questions.analysis: 定冠词后接名词，lose→loss（丧失）。

questions.stem: It's our duty ___ (save) endangered animals.
questions.analysis: It is + n. + to do，用不定式。

sections.name: 短文填空
sections.passage: Our planet is home to millions of ___ (1) ___ (species). But many are in ___ (2) ___ (dangerous) because of pollution and hunting. We can help by ___ (3) ___ (recycle) and saving energy. Everyone should try ___ (4) ___ (do) small things every day. When we protect nature, we protect ___ (5) ___ (we). A green earth is a ___ (6) ___ (gift) from us to the future.

questions.analysis: millions of species 意为'数百万物种'，species 单复同形。
in danger 固定搭配'处于危险中'。
by + doing，recycle→recycling。
try to do 意为'努力去做'，用不定式。
protect oneself 保护自己，we→ourselves。
a 后接单数名词，gift 原级（礼物/馈赠）。

sections.name: 阅读与回答问题
sections.passage: Elephants are the largest land animals. They live in families led by an old female. They use their long trunks to eat, drink and even hug. Sadly, elephants are endangered because people hunt them for ivory. Some countries have made laws to protect them. Tourists are asked not to buy any ivory products.

questions.stem: Who leads an elephant family?
questions.analysis: 细节定位第二句。

questions.stem: What do elephants use their trunks for?
questions.analysis: 细节第三句。

questions.stem: Why are elephants endangered?
questions.answer: Because people hunt them for ivory.
questions.analysis: 细节第四句。

questions.stem: What are tourists asked not to do?
questions.answer: Not to buy any ivory products.
questions.analysis: 末句直接要求。

sections.name: 书面表达
sections.prompt: 学校英语广播站征集“保护野生动物”主题短文，请你投稿，说明野生动物面临的威胁并提出两条保护建议。
sections.referenceOutline: 第一段：野生动物是朋友但面临危险；第二段：威胁（偷猎/栖息地丧失）；第三段：两条建议（拒买制品、保护环境）。
sections.referenceVersion: Wild animals are our friends, but many are in danger. Some are hunted for their fur or ivory, and others lose their homes because of deforestation. To protect them, first, we should never buy products made from wild animals. Second, we must keep the environment clean and plant more trees. If everyone does a little, we can give them a safer world. Let's act now!
sections.analysis: 评分要点：点明威胁、两条具体建议、连接词 first/second；常见失分：建议空洞、语法错误、词数不足。

papers.title: 南通市中考英语模拟试卷（八）
papers.theme: 学习方法·阅读策略与诚信
papers.structureNote: 按2025南通改革结构精简：覆盖全部7大题型。

questions.stem: I have ___ finished my reading project, so I can relax now.
questions.analysis: 考查现在完成时副词。肯定句表'刚刚'用 just；yet 用于疑问/否定。

questions.stem: English ___ widely as a global language in the world.
questions.analysis: 考查被动语态。English 与 speak 为被动，客观事实用一般现在时被动 is spoken。

questions.stem: —Need I go to the office now? —No, you ___.
questions.analysis: 考查情态动词。Need 开头的一般疑问句，否定回答用 needn't（不必）。

questions.stem: He had his broken bike ___ by the worker yesterday.
questions.analysis: 考查非谓语动词。have sth. done 表示'使某物被做'，用过去分词 repaired。

questions.stem: Hurry up, ___ you will be late for the meeting.
questions.analysis: 考查连词。祈使句 + or + 结果句，or 表'否则'。

questions.stem: He left the room ___ saying goodbye to anyone.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。'没道别就离开'用 without（没有）。

questions.stem: My ___ brother is a doctor in the city hospital.
questions.analysis: 考查形容词。表示'哥哥/长辈'用 elder（限定词前）；older 表年龄更大。

questions.stem: Can I ___ your pen for a minute? Mine is broken.
questions.analysis: 考查动词辨析。borrow 指'借入'，符合'借你的笔'。

questions.stem: —Can I borrow your ruler? —___ Here you are.
questions.analysis: 考查情景交际。同意借物用 Sure（当然可以）。

questions.stem: —How many students are there in the lab? —___. It's empty.
questions.analysis: 考查代词。问'多少学生'（可数复数），'一个也没有'用 none；no one 回答 who。

sections.name: 完形填空
sections.passage: On my way home, I found a wallet on the ground. It was full of money and a ___ (1) ___. I could keep it, but my father always told me to be ___ (2) ___. I stood there, not sure what to do. Then I decided to take it to the ___ (3) ___ station. The policeman found the owner, an old woman. She was so ___ (4) ___ and gave me a sweet. I felt ___ (5) ___ because I did the right thing. Honesty is not always easy, but it builds ___ (6) ___ between people. From that day, I understood that a clear ___ (7) ___ is worth more than any money. I will ___ (8) ___ this lesson all my life.

questions.analysis: 钱包里有钱和'名片/卡片'，card 符合常理。
父亲教导要'诚实'，honest 点明主题。
捡到钱包应送'警察'局，police 符合。
失主找回钱包应'感激'，thankful 符合。
做了正确的事感到'自豪'，proud 符合。
诚实建立人与人之间的'信任'，trust 符合。
a clear conscience 意为'问心无愧'，比金钱更可贵。
将铭记这堂课，remember 符合。

passages.title: School Reading Festival
passages.body:
Reading Festival is coming!
● Time: November 8–14.
● Activities: Book swap, story-telling contest, reading marathon.
● Prize: Top readers get book coupons.
● How to join: Bring a book to the library and sign up.
● Tip: Read at least 20 pages a day for the marathon.
Reading makes a full man!

questions.stem: When is the Reading Festival?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Time 一行写明 11 月 8–14 日。

questions.stem: What can top readers get?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Prize 一行写明书券。

questions.stem: How can students join the marathon?
options: B. Read at least 20 pages a day
questions.analysis: 细节题。Tip 写明每天至少读 20 页。

passages.title: The Right Choice
passages.body: During the final exam, Li Na found a note with answers under her desk. Her heart beat fast. She could copy and get a high mark. But she remembered her teacher's words: 'A grade is temporary; honesty lasts forever.' She pushed the note away and finished by herself. After the exam, she felt light and calm. She didn't get the top score, but she won something better—her own pride. Years later, she still thanks that decision.

questions.stem: What did Li Na find under her desk?
questions.analysis: 细节题。首段'found a note with answers'。

questions.stem: What did she do at last?
questions.analysis: 细节题。'pushed the note away and finished by herself'。

questions.stem: What did she win instead of a top score?
questions.analysis: 主旨/推理题。末段'won something better—her own pride'。

passages.title: How to Read More Efficiently
passages.body:
Reading is a skill you can improve.
____(1)____ Pick books that interest you, not just hard ones.
____(2)____ Guess the meaning of new words from the sentence around them.
____(3)____ Take notes of good sentences and review them later.
____(4)____ Read a little every day; consistency beats speed.
____(5)____ Share what you read with friends to deepen understanding.
options: D. Make it a daily habit.

questions.stem: 空白 (1) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'选感兴趣的书'对应'选你所爱'，A 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (2) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'根据上下文猜词义'对应'在语境中学词'，B 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (3) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'记好句并复习'对应'做阅读笔记'，C 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (4) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'每天读一点，坚持胜过速度'对应'养成日常习惯'，D 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (5) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'与朋友分享以加深理解'对应'谈论阅读'，E 匹配；F 为干扰项。

questions.stem: He made a ___ (decide) to study harder this term.
questions.analysis: make a decision 固定搭配，decide→decision（决定）。

questions.stem: The book is very ___ (help) for our English study.
questions.analysis: 作表语用形容词 helpful（有帮助的）。

questions.stem: She reads English ___ (loud) every morning to practice.
questions.analysis: read aloud 固定搭配'大声朗读'，用 aloud。

questions.stem: We should be ___ (honest) in the exam.
questions.analysis: be + adj.，honest 原级（诚实的）。

questions.stem: The teacher asked us ___ (not copy) others' homework.
questions.analysis: ask sb. (not) to do，用 not to copy。

questions.stem: He spent two hours ___ (read) the story yesterday.
questions.analysis: spend ... (in) doing，用 reading。

sections.name: 短文填空
sections.passage: Good readers have good ___ (1) ___ (habit). First, they read ___ (2) ___ (careful) and think about the meaning. Second, they guess the ___ (3) ___ (mean) of new words from the context. Third, they take ___ (4) ___ (note) while reading. Also, ___ (5) ___ (discuss) with classmates helps a lot. The more you read, the ___ (6) ___ (fast) you understand.

questions.analysis: good 后接复数名词，habit→habits（习惯）。
修饰动词 read 用副词 carefully。
the + 名词，mean→meaning（意思）。
take notes 固定搭配'做笔记'，用复数。
动名词作主语，discuss→discussing。
the + 比较级 …, the + 比较级 …，fast→faster。

sections.name: 阅读与回答问题
sections.passage: Honesty is a bright star in our life. Last week, Lin Tao found 200 yuan in the library. Instead of keeping it, he gave it to the teacher. The money was returned to its owner, a foreign student. The owner wrote a thank-you letter to the school. Lin Tao said, 'Doing the right thing makes me happy.' His act shows that small honesty lights up the world.

questions.stem: Where did Lin Tao find the money?
questions.analysis: 细节定位第二句。

questions.stem: How much money was it?
questions.analysis: 细节第二句。

questions.stem: What did he do with it?
questions.answer: He gave it to the teacher (who returned it to the owner).
questions.analysis: 细节第三句。

questions.stem: Why does he feel happy?
questions.answer: Because he did the right thing.
questions.analysis: 直接引用人物话语。

sections.name: 书面表达
sections.prompt: 学校英语俱乐部请你就（如何成为高效阅读者）写一篇短文，分享三条实用阅读方法。
sections.referenceOutline: 开头点题；三条方法（选感兴趣的书/语境猜词/每日坚持）；结尾鼓励。
sections.referenceVersion: Reading is a key to knowledge. Here are three tips for efficient reading. First, choose books you truly like, so you won't give up. Second, guess new words from the context instead of checking the dictionary all the time. Third, read a little every day because consistency matters more than speed. Try these and you will enjoy reading and learn faster. Happy reading!
sections.analysis: 评分要点：三条方法具体、使用 first/second/third、结尾鼓励；常见失分：方法空泛、语法错误、词数不足。

papers.title: 南通市中考英语模拟试卷（九）
papers.theme: 饮食健康·食品安全与社区
papers.structureNote: 按2025南通改革结构精简：覆盖全部7大题型。

questions.stem: Have you ___ been to the new science museum?
questions.analysis: 考查现在完成时副词。ever 用于疑问句中表'曾经'，符合语境。

questions.stem: The birthday cake ___ by my mom yesterday evening.
questions.analysis: 考查被动语态。cake 与 make 为被动，yesterday 用一般过去时被动 was made。

questions.stem: You ___ go to bed early; you look so tired.
questions.analysis: 考查情态动词。had better 表'最好'，后接动词原形，符合建议语境。

questions.stem: Let me ___ you with the heavy box.
questions.analysis: 考查非谓语动词。let sb. do sth. 用省略 to 的不定式。

questions.stem: I was reading a book ___ my mom came in.
questions.analysis: 考查连词。when 表示'正在做某事，这时（突然）…'，符合语境。

questions.stem: He is good ___ math, so he often helps me.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。be good at 为固定搭配，意为'擅长…'。

questions.stem: She has ___ friends in this city than I do.
questions.analysis: 考查比较级。than 前用比较级，friend 可数，many 比较级为 more。

questions.stem: My mom ___ delicious food for us every weekend.
questions.analysis: 考查动词辨析。cook 作动词'烹饪'，主语第三人称单数用 cooks。

questions.stem: —Sorry I'm late for the meal. —___
options: D. No problem at all (as thanks)
questions.analysis: 考查情景交际。回应道歉用 That's OK（没关系）。

questions.stem: Is there ___ wrong with the soup? It tastes strange.
questions.analysis: 考查代词。疑问句用 anything，'有什么不对劲吗'。

sections.name: 完形填空
sections.passage: Our community held a food festival last weekend. Families brought ___ (1) ___ dishes to share. My mother made dumplings, and the smell was ___ (2) ___. A cook from a local restaurant taught us to choose ___ (3) ___ food and read the date on packages. We learned that too much sugar and salt is ___ (4) ___ for health. The children made fruit salads with ___ (5) ___ own hands. In the end, we gave the leftover food to the poor. The festival not only filled our ___ (6) ___ but also brought neighbors ___ (7) ___. I think healthy eating and a warm community make a ___ (8) ___ life.

questions.analysis: 各家带'不同的'菜肴分享，different 符合。
饺子香味'很棒'，wonderful 符合。
厨师教选'新鲜'食材，fresh 符合食品安全主题。
过多糖盐对身体'有害'，bad 符合。
孩子们用'their'自己的手，与 children 对应。
美食节填饱'肚子'，stomachs 符合。
活动让邻里'更亲近'，closer 符合。
健康饮食与温暖社区成就'更好'的生活，better 点题。

passages.title: Healthy Eating Talk
passages.body:
Community Healthy Eating Talk
● Speaker: Dr. Lin, a food expert
● Time: This Sunday, 3:00–4:30 p.m.
● Place: Community Center, Room 1
● Topic: How to read food labels and eat balanced meals
● Free; all neighbors welcome
● Sign up at the front desk before Saturday

questions.stem: Who will give the talk?
options: B. Dr. Lin, a food expert
questions.analysis: 细节题。Speaker 一行写明 Dr. Lin。

questions.stem: What is the talk about?
options: B. Reading food labels and balanced meals
questions.analysis: 细节题。Topic 一行点明主题。

questions.stem: How can people sign up?
options: B. At the front desk before Saturday
questions.analysis: 细节题。末句写明周六前到前台报名。

passages.title: A Lesson from a Bad Egg
passages.body: Xiao Fang loves eggs. One morning, she took one from the fridge to make breakfast. It smelled a little odd, but she thought it was fine. After eating, she felt sick and went to the doctor. The doctor said, 'Always check the date and the smell before eating.' Xiao Fang learned that a small check can keep us safe. Now she reads the package date every time and never eats food that smells strange.

questions.stem: What happened to Xiao Fang?
options: B. She got sick after eating a bad egg
D. She met a doctor friend
questions.analysis: 细节题。'After eating, she felt sick' 说明吃坏蛋后生病。

questions.stem: What did the doctor advise?
options: B. Check date and smell first
questions.analysis: 细节题。医生原话'Always check the date and the smell'。

questions.stem: What is the lesson?
options: B. A small check keeps us safe
questions.analysis: 主旨题。末段点明'小检查保安全'。

passages.title: Eat for a Healthy Body
passages.body:
Good eating habits keep us strong.
____(1)____ Eat different kinds of food: grains, vegetables, meat and fruit.
____(2)____ Drink enough water and less sugary soda.
____(3)____ Eat meals at regular times and don't skip breakfast.
____(4)____ Wash fruit and cook meat well before eating.
____(5)____ When the whole family eats well, everyone stays happy.
options: D. Keep food clean and safe.
E. Eat together as a family.

questions.stem: 空白 (1) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'吃不同种类食物'对应'均衡膳食'，A 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (2) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'多喝水、少喝甜饮'对应'选择健康饮品'，B 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (3) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'规律进餐、不漏早餐'对应'规律用餐时间'，C 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (4) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'洗净水果、煮熟肉'对应'保持食物清洁安全'，D 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (5) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'全家一起吃好'对应'家庭共餐'，E 匹配；F 为干扰项。

questions.stem: We should eat more ___ (vegetable) and less meat.
questions.analysis: more 后接复数，vegetable→vegetables。

questions.stem: The soup tastes ___ (good) and we all like it.
questions.analysis: taste 为系动词，后接形容词 good 原级。

questions.stem: Too much sugar is ___ (health) for kids.
questions.analysis: too much sugar 对健康'有害'，health→unhealthy。

questions.stem: She ___ (cook) dinner for the family yesterday.
questions.analysis: yesterday 表过去，cook→cooked。

questions.stem: It's important ___ (drink) enough water every day.
questions.analysis: It is + adj. + to do，用不定式。

questions.stem: The food was so ___ (taste) that we ate it all.
questions.analysis: so + adj.，taste→tasty（美味的）。

sections.name: 短文填空
sections.passage: To eat ___ (1) ___ (safe), we should wash fruit before eating. Always check the ___ (2) ___ (produce) date on packages. Food that smells ___ (3) ___ (bad) must be thrown away. A ___ (4) ___ (balance) diet keeps us strong. We should eat ___ (5) ___ (little) junk food and more home-cooked meals. Good ___ (6) ___ (eat) habits start from today.

questions.analysis: 修饰动词 eat 用副词 safely。
production date 固定说法'生产日期'。
smell + adj.，用原级 bad（坏掉的）。
a balanced diet 固定搭配'均衡饮食'。
与 more 对应，little 比较级为 less。
eating habits 固定搭配'饮食习惯'。

sections.name: 阅读与回答问题
sections.passage: Food safety matters. Last month, a boy ate a hamburger from a street stall and got sick. Doctors said the meat was not fresh. To stay safe, we should buy food from clean places, wash hands before meals, and cook meat well. Reading the date on the package is also important. A healthy body begins with safe food.

questions.stem: What happened to the boy?
questions.answer: He ate a bad hamburger and got sick.
questions.analysis: 细节定位第二、三句。

questions.stem: Where did he buy the hamburger?
questions.analysis: 细节第三句。

questions.stem: What should we do to stay safe?
questions.answer: Buy from clean places, wash hands, cook meat well, read dates.
questions.analysis: 细节第四、五句综合。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.answer: Food safety is important for health.
questions.analysis: 末句点明主旨。

sections.name: 书面表达
sections.prompt: 请你给校报写一封短文，以（健康饮食）为题，给同学提出三条饮食建议。
sections.referenceOutline: 开头点题；三条建议（均衡膳食/少糖少垃圾食品/规律进餐）；结尾呼吁。
sections.referenceVersion: Healthy eating makes us strong. Here are three tips. First, eat a balanced diet with vegetables, fruit and grains every day. Second, drink more water and less sugary drinks, and say no to too much junk food. Third, have meals at regular times and never skip breakfast. Good habits start now. Let's eat well and grow healthy together!
sections.analysis: 评分要点：三条建议具体、使用 first/second/third、结尾呼吁；常见失分：建议空泛、语法错误、词数不足。

papers.title: 南通市中考英语模拟试卷（十）
papers.structureNote: 按2025南通改革结构精简：覆盖全部7大题型。第十套为收官卷。

questions.stem: We have known each other ___ we were children.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。since + 过去时间点（we were children），与现在完成时连用。

questions.stem: A new science lab ___ in our school next year.
questions.analysis: 考查被动语态。lab 与 build 为被动，next year 用一般将来时被动 will be built。

questions.stem: When I was five, I ___ ride a bike by myself.
questions.analysis: 考查情态动词。表过去的能力用 could（can 的过去式）。

questions.stem: He used ___ in the city, but now he lives in the countryside.
questions.analysis: 考查非谓语动词。used to do 表'过去常常'，用 to live。

questions.stem: ___ he is young, he knows a lot about space.
questions.analysis: 考查连词。'年轻'与'懂很多'为让步关系，用 Although。

questions.stem: The rocket flew ___ space and disappeared in the blue sky.
questions.analysis: 考查介词。fly into space 为固定表达，意为'飞入太空'。

questions.stem: The higher we fly, the ___ we can see.
questions.analysis: 考查比较级。the + 比较级 …, the + 比较级 … 结构，'越多…越…'。

questions.stem: He ___ his dream of becoming a pilot at last.
questions.analysis: 考查动词辨析。achieve one's dream 为固定搭配，意为'实现梦想'。

questions.stem: —I'm afraid I can't work out the problem. —___! You can do it.
questions.analysis: 考查情景交际。鼓励他人用 Come on（加油/振作）。

questions.stem: This T-shirt is too small; please show me ___ one.
questions.analysis: 考查代词。another 指'另一个'（三者或以上中的任意一个），符合语境。

sections.name: 完形填空
sections.passage: Since I was a child, I have dreamed of flying to ___ (1) ___. I watched every rocket launch on TV. My parents supported me and bought me books about ___ (2) ___. In middle school, I joined the science club and built small ___ (3) ___ with my friends. It was not easy; we failed many times. But our teacher said, 'Failure is the mother of ___ (4) ___.' We kept trying and finally won a prize. Now I study harder than before, because I know a dream needs both ___ (5) ___ and effort. I believe one day I will stand under the stars and say, 'I ___ (6) ___ it.' To young people, I want to say: never stop ___ (7) ___, for the sky is not the ___ (8) ___.

questions.analysis: 后文 rocket、stars 提示梦想飞向'太空'，space 符合。
父母买关于'太空'的书，space 呼应主题。
科学俱乐部制作小'模型'（火箭模型），models 符合。
Failure is the mother of success 谚语'失败是成功之母'。
梦想需要'勇气'与努力，courage 符合。
make it 为固定搭配，意为'成功做到'。
呼应开头梦想，'永不停止做梦/追梦'，dreaming 符合。
'天空不是极限'（天空不是终点），limit 升华主题。

passages.title: Young Astronaut Camp
passages.body:
Young Astronaut Camp is open for students!
● Age: 10–15
● Date: August 5–9
● Place: City Space Museum
● Activities: Visit a real simulator, make a model rocket, meet a space scientist.
● Cost: 300 yuan (lunch and kit included)
● Apply: Fill the form at www.spacecamp.cn before July 20.
Dream big, start small!

questions.stem: Who can join the camp?
questions.analysis: 细节题。Age 一行写明 10–15 岁。

questions.stem: What can students do at the camp?
options: A. Visit a simulator and make a model rocket
questions.analysis: 细节题。Activities 列出参观模拟器、做火箭模型、见科学家。

questions.stem: How can students apply?
options: B. Fill the form online before July 20
questions.analysis: 细节题。Apply 一行写明 7 月 20 日前网上报名。

passages.title: Wang Yaping in Space
passages.body: Wang Yaping is a Chinese astronaut. In 2013, she gave the first space lesson to students on Earth. In 2021, she flew to the space station on Shenzhou XIII and became the first Chinese woman to walk in space. During her six-month stay, she taught children again through a special class. She told young people, 'The stars are not far if you dare to reach.' Her story inspires millions of students to love science and dream big.

questions.stem: When did Wang Yaping give the first space lesson?
questions.analysis: 细节题。首段'In 2013, she gave the first space lesson'。

questions.stem: What made her special in 2021?
options: A. She flew to the Moon
B. She became the first Chinese woman to walk in space
questions.analysis: 细节题。'became the first Chinese woman to walk in space'。

questions.stem: What does her story show?
options: B. Dare to reach the stars
questions.analysis: 主旨题。末段引语与点题'敢于触及星辰'，B 最贴切。

passages.title: Grow Your Love for Science
passages.body:
Science is fun if you find the right way.
____(1)____ Ask questions about everyday things: why the sky is blue, how a phone works.
____(2)____ Do small experiments at home with simple tools.
____(3)____ Read science books or watch documentaries for fun.
____(4)____ Join a school club and learn with friends.
____(5)____ A curious mind today may become a great scientist tomorrow.

questions.stem: 空白 (1) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'对日常事物提问'对应'保持好奇'，A 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (2) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'在家做小实验'对应'自己动手尝试'，B 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (3) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'读书或看纪录片'对应'阅读与观看'，C 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (4) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'加入社团与朋友共学'对应'一起学习'，D 匹配。

questions.stem: 空白 (5) 应选
questions.analysis: 后文'好奇的心或成科学家'对应'畅想未来'，E 匹配；F 为干扰项。

questions.stem: China ___ (send) three astronauts into space last year.
questions.analysis: last year 表过去，send→sent。

questions.stem: The dream is ___ (achieve) if you work hard.
questions.analysis: 作表语用形容词 achievable（可实现的）。

questions.stem: He is ___ (interest) in science fiction books.
questions.analysis: be interested in 固定搭配'对…感兴趣'。

questions.stem: They practiced ___ (fly) the model rocket in the park.
questions.analysis: practice doing，用 flying。

questions.stem: It took years of work ___ (become) a real pilot.
questions.analysis: It takes time to do，用不定式。

questions.stem: The news was ___ (excite) for all of us.
questions.analysis: 修饰事用 -ing 形容词 exciting（令人兴奋的）。

sections.name: 短文填空
sections.passage: Space is full of ___ (1) ___ (mystery). Scientists ___ (2) ___ (study) the stars for centuries. With powerful telescopes, we can see ___ (3) ___ (far) than before. China's space station shows that ___ (4) ___ (human) can work in orbit. Young people should learn science so that they can ___ (5) ___ (explore) the unknown. The universe is so big that there is always something new ___ (6) ___ (wait) for us.

questions.analysis: full of 后接复数，mystery→mysteries（奥秘）。
for centuries 与现在完成时连用，study→have studied。
than 前用比较级，far→farther/further（更远）。
that 后接复数主语，human→humans（人类）。
can 后接动词原形 explore。
现在分词作后置定语，wait→waiting。

sections.name: 阅读与回答问题
sections.passage: On October 16, 2021, the Shenzhou XIII spacecraft sent three astronauts to China's space station. They stayed there for six months, doing experiments and giving space lessons to students on Earth. Wang Yaping became the first Chinese woman to walk in space. Their work shows that with hard work, ordinary young people can reach for the stars.

questions.stem: When did Shenzhou XIII go into space?
questions.analysis: 细节定位首句。

questions.stem: How long did the astronauts stay there?
questions.analysis: 细节第二句。

questions.stem: Who was the first Chinese woman to walk in space?
questions.analysis: 细节第三句。

questions.stem: What can young people learn from them?
questions.answer: With hard work, ordinary youth can reach for the stars.
questions.analysis: 末句点明主旨。

sections.name: 书面表达
sections.prompt: 学校英语演讲比赛主题为（我的梦想），请你写一篇英文演讲稿，谈谈你的梦想（如成为宇航员或探索宇宙）以及为实现它你将如何努力。
requirements: 包含梦想内容与行动规划
sections.referenceOutline: 开头问候+点明梦想；正文说明为何及如何努力（学习/science/坚持）；结尾鼓励大家追梦。
sections.referenceVersion: Good morning, everyone! My dream is to become an astronaut and explore the stars. Space is full of mystery, and I want to know it better. To make it come true, I will study science hard, read more books, and never give up when facing difficulties. I believe where there is a dream, there is a way. Let's chase our dreams bravely and reach for the stars. Thank you!
sections.analysis: 评分要点：梦想明确、行动具体、使用连接词与号召性结尾；常见失分：空喊口号无计划、语法错误、词数不足。
